نتسلسل (form IIq)
# نَتَسَلْسَلُ (natasalsalu) /na.ta.sal.sa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَلْسَلَ (tasalsala)
# نَتَسَلْسَلَ (natasalsala) /na.ta.sal.sa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَلْسَلَ (tasalsala)
# نَتَسَلْسَلْ (natasalsal) /na.ta.sal.sal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَلْسَلَ (tasalsala)
